name: Fruity Cannabis Crispy | 200mg
description: Detroit Edibles has taken Fruity Pebbles cereal and transformed it into a delicious crispy and gooey marshmallow treat. If you’re a fan of delicious fruity flavors, this is the edible for you. Each crispy contains a potent 200mg of THC and will marsh-MELLOW you out with every bite. Fully activates in 1-2 hours.
